verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML/KYC risk platform, so phone, email and device risk signals are a fair axis for it. The evidence only documents sanctions, PEP, watchlist and adverse-media screening, configurable risk scoring, and transaction monitoring. Nothing shows carrier checks, email risk, address history or device fingerprinting as documented check types, and the configurable risk score is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
